source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 暗助试招，险中成势
title: 暗助试招，险中成势
purpose: 承接 SC18 的试探开端：唐七先用虚招探拓拔野；白衣女子暗中传音提醒；唐七骤然出真招；拓拔野被无形之力托起，在狼狈中连环踢出，误打误撞将唐七踢飞。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、招式名文字或任何可读文本。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 唐七虚招 / 白衣女子传音 / 腾空乱抓 / 踢飞唐七。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 and SH02 anchor to the SC18 challenge storyboard. SH03 and SH04 anchor to the same challenge storyboard so Tuobaye, Tang Qi, and the white-clothed woman stay in one consistent gate-space relationship.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, taunts, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 不要动，他这七拳全是虚招，要探你虚实。
公子别怕，我不会让你摔下来的。
想不到我刚伸伸懒腰，他却先比我睡着了。
